name: Seadramon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your blue Digimon cannot be deleted in battle until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play another Digimon by an effect, 1 of your blue Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
